title: refactor(metadata-protocol): move the artifact registry's lookups out of protocol.ts into protocol-artifact-lookup.ts (#25467 cut 15)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X7JKgiM29GUcitRvoGGj5BU)_

Part of #25467
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none
Ruling-ref: 6270097840

Cut 15 of the `protocol.ts` split (#24586 ruling A, recorded in `6270097840`). Cuts 1–14 landed as #25494, #25518, #25538, #25589, #25601, #25623, #25642, #25719, #25731, #25740, #25797, #25939, #25972 and #26014. The claim is `6414543503`; the scope is the cut 15 proposal of the cut 14 report (`6412300878`), as the server seat approved it in its dispatch order: the whole family, with the #22024 pin widened (the pin edit held, so the pin-free fallback was not needed).

Four `ObjectStackProtocolImplementation` members move unedited into a new module, `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-artifact-lookup.ts` (#23050 shape B). They are the artifact registry's lookups from the ADR-0010 section:

- `lookupArtifactItem`: an item's artifact.
- `shippedArtifactsOf`: every package's artifact for an item.
- `shippingPackagesOf`: the packages that can ship an item of a type.
- `artifactLockLayerAt`: the item-lock resolution's artifact layer.

`protocol.ts` loses 48 net lines (29,488 to 29,440). The cut is move-only, and the card stays open for later cuts.

Branch `claude/project-thread-ybjm3h` is the harness-pinned branch for this thread, restarted from `main` `3117289002` after cut 14 merged. It names no issue, so the claim comment is the identity record. It holds the commit `dd85dd1b4` (the move and the pin edit together: the move alone turns the pin red, as the control below shows) and two merges of `main`: `be7897799` (`59e0b7e0f`) and `aa2f8e31f` (`9840a879d`). Neither touches `packages/metadata-protocol/`: the package's `src/` tree is `af425909` at `3117289002` and at both merged `main` heads.

**Serial with the file's in-flight PRs.** Measured just before this PR was opened: of the 39 open PRs, one touches `packages/metadata-protocol/src/`. #26005 edits `protocol.meta-types-degenerate-derivation.test.ts`, which does not overlap this cut. No open PR edits `protocol.ts`, the new module or the #22024 pin.

## What moves

| Member | Base line | Visibility | Body lines | AST tokens (params + return + body) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `lookupArtifactItem` | `:16493` | private | 24 | 162 |
| `artifactLockLayerAt` | `:16533` | private | 3 | 43 |
| `shippedArtifactsOf` | `:16558` | private | 14 | 184 |
| `shippingPackagesOf` | `:16594` | private | 39 | 406 |

80 body lines (the proposal said about 80).

## The shape (#23050 shape B, as cuts 1–14 apply it)

- **The class keeps every member** with its name, docblock, signature and position. Each body is now one host literal plus a `.call`, marked `[#25467 cut 15]`.
- **Typing.** `ArtifactLookupHost` types every member as the class member itself (an indexed access on `ObjectStackProtocolImplementation`). Each moved function types its `this` as the `Pick` of the host over exactly the members its body reads. Each stub annotates its literal as `ThisParameterType` of `typeof fn`. No member changes visibility.
- **Members read, measured by AST walk** (property and element accesses on `this`, with `as` casts, parentheses and `!` stripped; bare `this` checked too):
  - `lookupArtifactItem` and `shippingPackagesOf` read `engine` only, through a live getter.
  - `shippedArtifactsOf` reads `lookupArtifactItem` and `shippingPackagesOf`, and `artifactLockLayerAt` reads `shippedArtifactsOf`; each goes as a closure.
  - So the family reaches its own members **through the class methods**, not by calling the module's functions directly. A spy or double set on the instance (for example on `lookupArtifactItem`) is still the one `shippedArtifactsOf` reaches, as before the move.
- **No private-static read.** The AST walk found no access on the `ObjectStackProtocolImplementation` identifier and none on `this.constructor`, in any of the four bodies. 0 `new Error(` (and no other error constructor), so no `PRODUCERS` row.
- **Every other caller still calls the class method**: the 18 `lookupArtifactItem(` sites in `protocol.ts` (the #22024 table), `getEffectiveLock`, the read doors and the list for `artifactLockLayerAt`, and `readFlattenedMetaItems` and the others for `shippingPackagesOf`.

## Module-level declarations, by reader

- **None gains `export`, none moves.** The bodies read `PLURAL_TO_SINGULAR` (from `@objectstack/spec/shared`), `resolveArtifactLockLayer` and the type `ItemAddress` (from `./item-lock.js`), which the new module imports from where `protocol.ts` imports them, and `ShippingPackages`, `protocol.ts`'s own exported type, imported as a type. The module's only import from `./protocol.js` is a type import, so it adds no runtime cycle.
- **Imports in `protocol.ts`.** `resolveArtifactLockLayer` loses its last reader and leaves the `./item-lock.js` import (its two `{@link}` mentions in docblocks stay as prose). The one new statement is the import of the new module.

## The #22024 call-site pin, widened

`protocol.lookup-artifact-item-call-sites.test.ts` records a disposition for every `lookupArtifactItem(` in the source. The move takes three of them into the new module (the function the class member delegates to, and `shippedArtifactsOf`'s two calls) and adds one in `protocol.ts` (the stub's host closure, `lookupArtifactItem: (...a) => this.lookupArtifactItem(...a)`). The edit:

- The pin reads `protocol-artifact-lookup.ts` beside `protocol.ts`. It scans the seam with a module-function header (`export [async] function NAME(`), and keys each site by file as well as member and argument text.
- `shippedArtifactsOf`'s two rows move to the seam file, unchanged: same arguments, same disposition, same reason.
- **Two new rows.** The seam function's own definition. And the stub's closure `(...a)`: disposition `no`, recorded as passing no package because it forwards the package-less call too, and its disposition is the two forwarded calls'.
- The non-vacuity case now expects one definition in each file. One new case asserts that the seam file's found sites are exactly its recorded rows, three of them, so a scan that read the wrong file or none cannot pass by accident.
- The describe and existing test titles are unchanged, so the suite comparison below keys on the same names. The header prose says the population is two files now.

**Controls** (each on disk, restored from `HEAD` under a trap, hash equal to `HEAD`'s after):

- **The widened pin catches a re-scoped call in the seam.** `this.lookupArtifactItem(type, name, packageId)` was changed to `this.lookupArtifactItem(type, name)` in the module. On-disk counts read first: 0 scoped calls, 2 package-less. Result: 2 failed, 3 passed:
  - "the sites in the source are exactly the recorded ones" fails: a recorded site that is no longer in the source.
  - The new seam-scan case fails.
- **The pin had to be widened.** The pin file at base, run against the cut: 2 failed, 2 passed:
  - "a site with no recorded disposition", which is the new closure site.
  - `expected 18 to be 19`.

With the widened pin, 5/5 pass.

## The published `.d.ts`

The series bar is ruling `6348891160`, sorted-union identity, measured first. Base `3117289002` and head `dd85dd1b4` were built with `pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol build` against one dependency tree. The closure was built at head by a full `pnpm build` (119/119). For the base build, the package's `src/` was swapped tree-only to base and then restored from `HEAD` under a trap; `git diff HEAD` was empty, `git status` clean, and all three touched blobs equal to `HEAD`'s after. Measured twice: on the pre-merge tree (base `3117289002`, head `dd85dd1b4`) and after merging `main` (head `59e0b7e0f`, closure rebuilt by a full `pnpm build`, 119/119; the later merge `9840a879d` changed only CI workflow files and scripts under `ui/` and `scripts/`, no package source). The readings below hold for both.

- **Raw sha256**: `08914e65f936a2b031c3f3f215481a97f53d132eefd869e4f42d928947ebe173` at base and at head, on both `dist/index.d.ts` and `dist/index.d.cts`, 775,874 bytes each. **Raw identity holds**, so sorted-union identity holds too. All four members stay `private NAME;` lines.
- **Normalised sha256**: `46ccd7e5c4db673652513d1801ec9c9f06bf34a0a7fb6ba97fb2531ef0cc544b` at both ends (80 string-literal union runs sorted; the cut 12 normaliser).
- **The two builds differ where they should**: `index.js` hashes `13ff6c73088affd6…` at base and `5671669a82bc3837…` at head; each of the four functions' `.call(host` sites occurs 0 times in the base bundles and once in the head bundles (ESM and CJS alike).
- **Positive control** on the head tree: `private` was dropped from `lookupArtifactItem` (on disk, restored from `HEAD` under a trap) and the package rebuilt. Both `.d.ts` files move to `4290e8428fa3c8f5…` and print `lookupArtifactItem(type: string, name: string, currentPackageId?: string, member?: string): unknown;`, so the bar can see a change on these members.
- **Export tables.** The ESM and CJS bundles, loaded at runtime from the package, each export the same 78 names at base and head; the sorted list hashes to `9f18a0177ac736ed…` on all four. No moved function, the host type or `resolveArtifactLockLayer` appears.

No changeset: `skip-changeset`, per ruling `6348891160`.

## Proof of move-only

**Bodies, by AST token** (the TypeScript compiler's AST leaf tokens, JSDoc skipped, over parameters less the added `this`, return type and body), base `protocol.ts` at `3117289002` against the head module:

```

artifactLockLayerAt: base tokens 43, head tokens 43, differ 0, text-equal(ws-collapsed, comments incl.) true
shippedArtifactsOf: base tokens 184, head tokens 184, differ 0, text-equal(ws-collapsed, comments incl.) true
shippingPackagesOf: base tokens 406, head tokens 406, differ 0, text-equal(ws-collapsed, comments incl.) true
TOTAL tokens=795 differ=0 members=4
CLASS members base=300 head=300 order-same=true byte-identical=296 stubs-with-identical-docblock+signature=4 other=[]
TOP base=243 head=244 byte-identical=242
```

**Negative control**, one token changed in an in-memory copy of the head module (`id !== 'sys_metadata'` to `id === 'sys_metadata'`, one occurrence):

```

lookupArtifactItem: base tokens 162, head tokens 162, differ 0, text-equal(ws-collapsed, comments incl.) true
artifactLockLayerAt: base tokens 43, head tokens 43, differ 0, text-equal(ws-collapsed, comments incl.) true
shippedArtifactsOf: base tokens 184, head tokens 184, differ 0, text-equal(ws-collapsed, comments incl.) true
shippingPackagesOf: base tokens 406, head tokens 406, differ 1, text-equal(ws-collapsed, comments incl.) false
TOTAL tokens=795 differ=1 members=4
```

- **Class side.** 300 members at base and at head, in the same order. The 296 that did not move are byte-identical to base, leading comments included. Each of the 4 stubs sits at its base position and keeps its docblock and signature byte-identical (everything before the body's opening brace).
- **Top level of `protocol.ts`.** 242 of the 243 base statements are byte-identical, leading comments included. The other one is the `./item-lock.js` import, which loses `resolveArtifactLockLayer`. Head adds one statement, the new module's import.
- **Size.** +231 / −87 over 3 files, 318 changed lines (the proposal's estimate was 330–400). `protocol-artifact-lookup.ts` has 158 lines; the pin edit is +50/−16.

## Readers of the moved lines

Every test and script that reads `protocol.ts` by path, every test file in `packages/` and `ui/`, and `docs/`, `scripts/` and `content/` were grepped for the four member names.

- **By path:** only the #22024 pin reads a moved body's text (above). `protocol.register-item-call-sites.test.ts` names `shippedArtifactsOf` only inside a docblock; its by-path regex is on `anotherPackageShips`, which stays. The other by-path readers of `protocol.ts` (`protocol.hydrate-overlay-canonical-type`, `protocol.read-verb-canonical-fold`, `protocol.object-registry-write-through-spelling`, `protocol.recovery-doors-emit-mutation`, `protocol.recovery-doors-mutation-projector`) do not read these bodies; all ran in the package suite and pass at both ends.
- **In prose or behaviour, no edit owed.**
  - metadata-protocol `protocol.lock-gate-canonical-type.test.ts` drives the lookup through the gate (behaviour). `protocol.declines-stored-row-published` and `protocol.i18n-bundle-list-merge` name it in comments. All pass at both ends.
  - Run at head under the verify lock:
    - objectql `protocol-registry-shadow`, `protocol-boot-hydration-scoped` and `environment-overlay-email-locale-restart` (comments; behaviour through the class): 3 files, 61/61.
    - rest `meta-published-overlay`: 16/16.
    - runtime `meta-published-runtime-publish`: 12/12.
  - ui `PermissionMatrixEditor.artifactTier.test.tsx` and `ResourceEditPage.resetVerdict.test.tsx` name it in comments only.
- No hit in `docs/`, `scripts/` or `content/`; `docs/qa/` cites none of the four.
- **ADR anchors.** `check-adr-anchors` exits 0 at both ends: 88 anchored files, citations 59,047 → 59,048 (the new module's header cites ADR-0010), files 8,289 → 8,290, decision-letter citations **1,864 at both ends**. The moved comments cite `ADR-0010 §3.3`, `ADR-0048` and `ADR-0029 D3`. The `D3` one sits in `shippedArtifactsOf`'s docblock, which stays in `protocol.ts`, so no decision-letter citation leaves the anchored file.
- **Durability checker**: `check-durability-degradation-log-level` exits 0 at both ends with identical output, and its `--list` is identical once `[@:][0-9]+` is stripped (159 lines). `shippingPackagesOf`'s `try { … } catch { return []; }` around a registry listing is not on the list (it reads no store).
- **Engine-double contract** (`check-engine-double-contract`): exits 0 at both ends. The `updateData`/`deleteData` seams keep their entries at new line numbers (14086 → 14087, 14111 → 14112). `productionFiles` is 3,718 at base and 3,720 at head: +1 is the new file, +1 is the gitignored `packages/spec/src/migrations/registry.ts` the spec build writes in the head tree.
- **Identical output at both ends:** `check-adr-symbol-anchors`, `check-system-context-census`, `check-tenant-audit-census`, `check-query-options-erasure-ratchet`, `check-filter-alias-parity`. `check-nul-bytes` differs only in the scanned file count, +1. The base-end readings were taken in a clean detached worktree at `3117289002`.
- **Governed surface.** `check-governed-merges --branch claude/project-thread-ybjm3h`: 0 of 3 paths hit the register, NOT governed; 318 changed lines, under the 3,000-line human-merge bar.

## Verification

- `tsc --noEmit` in `packages/metadata-protocol` exits 0 before and after the merge (after the full build; the first run, on a stale dependency tree, failed only in `protocol-package-install*.ts` on `@objectstack/metadata-core` exports that the build then supplied). `pnpm exec eslint --no-inline-config packages/metadata-protocol` (the whole touched package; it has no `lint` script, these are the root `lint` script's flags) exits 0, no output.
- **`packages/metadata-protocol` suite**, base and head, compared per test name and status (vitest `--maxWorkers=2`, JSON reporter, each run under the shared verify lock, `VERDICT command-exit 0` both legs), on the pre-merge tree (the merge changed no file of the package):
  - Base `3117289002`: 21,557 tests (21,538 passed, 0 failed, 19 skipped), 269 files.
  - Head `dd85dd1b4`: 21,558 tests (21,539 passed, 0 failed, 19 skipped), 269 files.
  - None lost, none changed status, one added: the pin's new seam-scan case. The base leg is the package `src/` swapped tree-only from `3117289002` (the new module removed, the pin at its base blob) and restored from `HEAD` under a trap.
- `check-platform-checklist --changed-from origin/main` (merged tree): OK, 1 anchored file in the change set, 29 anchors judged, 0 lost.
- **Derived gates.** `dispatch-gates --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derives 59 gates on 3 changed paths from the merged tree `9840a879d`, with no stale-tree warning (the first derivation, at `59e0b7e0f`, flagged `ci.yml` and `check-closing-keyword-parity.mjs` as changed on `main`, so `main` was merged once more before running). All 59 exit 0 after the full `pnpm build`. `dispatch-gates --ran`: 59 derived, 59 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN, exit 0.

## Acceptance notes

- **Per-call cost.** `lookupArtifactItem` is the family's hot member (18 class call sites, some in list loops). Its stub now builds a one-getter host literal per call, as every shape-B stub in this series does. No behaviour or result changes; this is noted only because the lookup runs per listed item.
- **The family reaches itself through the class.** `shippedArtifactsOf` and `artifactLockLayerAt` call their siblings through host closures on the protocol, not through the module's functions. That keeps instance spies and doubles effective, as above. A later redesign that wants the module to stand alone would be a behaviour change for such doubles, not a move.

## Carry-forward

Unchanged from cut 14: these stay in `protocol.ts`:

- Public members whose return type is inferred.
- The bodies kept by a reader: `probeRecord`, `getMetaItemCached`, `findReferencesToMeta`, `packagelessAddress`, `refuseUnmintableMetaType`, `metaTypeNamespaceExists`, `viewContainerNameCollisionRefusal` with `overlaidShippedContainerViewNames`, `reportPageRequiresAbsentAtLoad`, the 7 `applyRegistryWriteThrough` callers, and `readCodeLayerForCarryForward`.
- The private-static readers: `refusePackagedBaseRemoval`, `packagedBaseRefusal`, `runPublishSideEffects`, `promoteDraftForPublish`, `publishPackageDrafts` and `discardPackageDrafts`.
- The field writers: `warnClosureReadUnavailable`.
